name: Member
definition: A person on the student club roster, identified by member_id, with a name, email, phone, t-shirt size, club position, and links to a declared academic major and a residential ZIP code.
scope: Membership roster analysis over the member table (33 records).

name: Club Event
definition: A scheduled club activity such as a meeting, guest speaker, game, social, community service activity, election, registration or budget review, carrying a name, timestamp, type, location and status.
scope: Event planning and participation analysis over the event table (42 records).

name: Budget Line Item
definition: An allocation of club funds for a spending category tied to a specific event, recording the amount allocated, the amount spent and the remaining balance.
scope: Budget planning and utilisation analysis over the budget table (52 records).

name: Expense
definition: An individual expenditure with a description, date, cost and approval flag, attributed to a member and charged against a budget line item.
scope: Expense tracking and approval analysis over the expense table (32 records).

name: Income Record
definition: A receipt of funds by the club from a source such as membership dues, fundraising, sponsorship or school appropriation, optionally attributed to a member.
scope: Revenue analysis over the income table (36 records).

name: Attendance Record
definition: A link recording that a specific member attended a specific event. The attendance table carries no attributes beyond the event and member references.
scope: Participation analysis wherever attendance rows exist (326 rows over 17 events and 30 members).

name: Academic Major
definition: An academic programme of study with a name, department and college, used as the declared major of a club member.
scope: Academic composition analysis over the major table (113 majors).

name: ZIP Code Reference
definition: A United States postal ZIP code reference record giving the locality type, city, county and state for a numeric ZIP code.
scope: Geographic reference and member location analysis; the zip_code table is a 41877-row reference table covering US postal codes.

name: Club Position
definition: The role a member holds in the club: President, Vice President, Treasurer, Secretary, Member or Inactive.
scope: Role-based segmentation of the member table.

name: Event Type
definition: The category of a club event: Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Social, Community Service, Election, Registration or Budget.
scope: Event categorisation in the event table.

name: Event Status
definition: The lifecycle state of a club event: Open, Planning or Closed.
scope: Event lifecycle analysis in the event table.

name: Budget Event Status
definition: The event lifecycle state recorded on a budget line item. It shares the value domain Open, Planning, Closed with event status and always agrees with the status of the linked event.
scope: Redundant copy of event status carried on the budget table.

name: Budget Category
definition: The spending category of a budget line item: Food, Advertisement, Parking, Speaker Gifts or Club T-Shirts.
scope: Budget allocation analysis by category.

name: Income Source
definition: The origin of club income: Dues, Fundraising, Sponsorship or School Appropration.
scope: Revenue segmentation in the income table.

name: College
definition: The academic college or school that hosts a major, such as College of Engineering or School of Business. Eight distinct values exist in the major table.
scope: Academic organisation analysis; naming is not uniform across values.

name: Member State
definition: The US state of a member's residential address, obtained through the member's ZIP code rather than stored directly on the member record.
scope: Geographic distribution analysis of members.

name: Member ZIP Code
definition: The residential ZIP code recorded on a member record, identifying the same postal geography as the ZIP code reference table.
scope: Member address analysis; stored as an integer so leading zeros are not preserved.

name: Attendance Count
definition: The number of attendance records associated with an event or with a member, counting distinct event-member links.
scope: Participation volume measurement over the attendance table.

name: Budgeted Amount
definition: The total funds allocated to a budget line item before any spending.
scope: Budget planning measurement.

name: Budget Spent Amount
definition: The funds consumed against a budget line item, equal to the sum of the costs of the expenses charged to it.
scope: Budget consumption measurement; reconciles exactly with linked expense records.

name: Budget Remaining Amount
definition: The funds still available on a budget line item, defined as the allocated amount minus the spent amount. It becomes negative when the line item is overspent.
scope: Budget availability measurement.

name: Budget Utilisation Rate
definition: The proportion of a budget line item that has been consumed, computed as the spent amount divided by the allocated amount.
scope: Budget efficiency comparison across categories and events.

name: Expense Cost
definition: The monetary amount of a single expense record.
scope: Expense-level measurement feeding budget consumption.

name: Income Amount
definition: The monetary amount received in a single income record.
scope: Revenue measurement at the individual receipt level.

name: Member Count
definition: The number of member records on the roster, including members whose position is Inactive.
scope: Roster size measurement.

name: Dues Income
definition: The portion of club income received from membership dues, paid in uniform amounts per member.
scope: Recurring membership revenue measurement.
